name: cross-env-reload-rebind
title: Reload must rebind worker-thread script instances in their owning env
description: Fix GodotJSScript::load_module_immediately so reloading a script rebinds each script instance in the Environment that owns it: the calling env rebinds synchronously, other envs (worker/shadow) are notified and rebind on their own thread. Resolves the jsb_script.cpp:942 TODO and the :285 cross-env invalidation TODO.
